title: Bench PiD 1.5 (newer nvidia-pid upscaler generation): REPLACE, ADD or DROP
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. Split out of MPI-343 (merged into MPI-1179, 2026-10-18).
